research_question: How does the recorded TD/Indeterminate/PIGD label move between consecutive visits, and how much of that movement is noise?
method: Contingency transition matrix, Wilson intervals, interval stratification, reversion-after-change, Kaplan-Meier time to PIGD, pathway enumeration
dataset: PPMI sporadic PD, frozen panel: 1,080 patients / 5,774 visits / 4,441 labelled; 934 patients contribute 3,361 consecutive labelled pairs
validation: Descriptive; Wilson intervals at visit level (no patient clustering)
key_results: TD->TD 0.808; PIGD->PIGD 0.702; Indeterminate persistence 0.192; 35.2% of changes revert; KM naive 35.3% vs sustained 15.3% at 5 y
potential_duplication: Subtype_Progression_Report and Project_Report restate the same transition results; Pipeline_Walkthrough traces them to code
issues: Wilson intervals ignore repeated visits within patient; superseded by E-2's patient-clustered bootstrap, which widens every interval (ratio 0.96-1.20)

experiment_documented: Discrete Markov / CTMC / CT-HMM held-out comparison (scripts/03, outputs/model)
research_question: Is a Markov chain in the observed label adequate, and does a latent state with misclassification do better?
method: Discrete-time Markov chain, continuous-time Markov chain, 3-state CT-HMM with emission matrix; chi-square Markov-property test
dataset: Frozen panel; held-out split of 1,002 transition pairs
key_results: Markov property rejected in all three states (p=7.9e-33 TD, 0.0041 Indet, 1.7e-12 PIGD); held-out accuracy HMM 0.7695 > DTMC 0.7675 > CTMC 0.7655 > marginal 0.6248; HMM log-lik/pair -0.6384
potential_duplication: Week5-7_Walkthrough narrates the same work; Project_Report and Subtype_Progression_Report summarise it
issues: Single split, not LOO; superseded for the headline number by outputs/loo (934-fold LOPO, accuracy 0.7539)

research_question: Does any of the continuous-outcome modelling after the HMM improve prediction, and can patients be clustered into phenotypes?
method: GPR with four kernels; joint subscore LMM; multi-output GP (K0/K1 diag/full); spline time-varying LMM; slope-reliability and null-model clustering audit
dataset: Frozen panel; LOPO cohorts per analysis; 934 patients / 3,361 pairs for subscore models
validation: Leave-one-patient-out and nested paired bootstrap; explicitly distinguishes pooled from patient-level aggregation
key_results: GP beats persistence on the ratio by -0.0707 MAE [-0.0979, -0.0451]; cross-output correlation ~0; no subscore model beats persistence on PIGD (all paired deltas positive and excluding zero); progression rate changes but prediction does not improve; clustering rejected (slope reliability 0.270 tremor / 0.531 PIGD, null reproduces the signals)
completeness: Complete, and the most rigorous document in either folder
potential_duplication: BTP_Post_Midterm_Report covers the same stages briefly; docs/GPR_onwards_explanatory_report.md is its Markdown source
issues: Dated 9 October 2026. It ends by naming 'Direction 4' as the next question - that direction is the entire probabilistic TD-PIGD prediction programme, and nothing in either report folder documents it
